name: hell_mode_no_talent
about: Hell Mode story Short: at the Appraisal Ceremony his childhood friend Krena is a Sword Lord, one of the best talents there is; Allen steps up sure his parents will finally learn he is a Summoner - and the reverend reads 'no talent', all E ranks, a text glitch nobody else can see. The drop runs what the 'talentless' serf summons; he ends deciding to drop the act.
song: /mnt/datadisk/song/Death Note Theme Hip Hop Trap REMIX.mp3

story.why: Krena has the talent of a Sword Lord, one of the best there is
Allen: finally my parents will know that I'm a Summoner
does he have a talent? ...he has no talent
a text glitch, useless devs - now nobody will know I'm a summoner

outro.why: time to drop the act - a talentless serf like me can draw a little attention

title: His Friend Got The Best Talent There Is... He Got NONE - Hell Mode
hook: Krena is appraised a Sword Lord. Allen, the reincarnated gamer who picked Hell Mode, is told he has no talent - all E ranks - because nobody can read the word Summoner.
